summary: China Automotive Systems, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report) disclosing its November 11, 2026 press release: preliminary record third-quarter 2026 EPS unit sales (567,314 units, +40.1% y/y; 1,461,381 for nine months, +32.7%) plus board approval of a share repurchase program of up to $5 million of common shares, capped at $5.50 per share, running through November 10, 2027. Repurchases are open-market, at prevailing prices, timing and amount subject to market conditions and applicable approvals; no advisor named. Watch actual buyback pace and per-share ceiling versus trading price, a signal of perceived undervaluation rather than a control event.
